Range 60 feet

Targets 1 creature that owes you a debt or that failed a Will save against one of your effects this encounter

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

A heavy mental strike that can strip an item from a debtor.

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or take @Damage[10d6[mental]] damage and one item it's holding (your choice, GM adjudicates fairness) becomes off-guard for you to Steal or Disarm for 1 round; on a critical failure it also drops that item. On a success, it takes half damage only. The Ledger doesn't forgive foreclosure.
